subject: Do not kill qwen_http child alone: ProRun watchdog/supervisor will restart it
body: Read-only inspection of C:\ProgramData\ProRun\runtime reveals qwen_http is supervised at two layers. start-qwen.ps1 loops forever, Start-Process -Wait on qwen_http.py, sleeps 5s on exit, then restarts when free VRAM >=3400 MiB. ProRun Watchdog runs every minute and restarts scheduled task 'ProRun Qwen Endpoint' if it is not Running. Therefore killing PID5888 alone or only stopping the Qwen task can race/restart onto the GPU. Safe R2 handoff after source/preflight ACK: stop/pause scheduled task 'ProRun Watchdog' first, then stop scheduled task 'ProRun Qwen Endpoint' (optionally ProRun Daemon as it depends on the endpoint); verify qwen_http PID is gone and nvidia-smi compute list empty / memory 0; run exact live R2 host preflight; only then launch one R2 attempt under held lease. After R2 terminal state, restore 'ProRun Qwen Endpoint', then 'ProRun Daemon' if stopped, then 'ProRun Watchdog', and verify endpoint recovery. Do not use child-PID kill as the normal handoff path.
